methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Growth → next-stage step-up multiplier (1.2x) to $10M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 10 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Emelody operates in Robotics & Manufacturing at the Growth stage, having raised $10M+ to date. The comparable universe spans 10 same-sector peers (1 public, 8 private), including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics. However, the peer set lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within Emelody's valuation tier to support a reliable peer-median approach.

Consequently, valuation relies primarily on stage-progression methodology. Using the $10M total raised as a base proxy and applying a 1.2x step-up multiplier typical for Growth-stage advancement, this method implies a valuation of $12M. The narrow applicability of comparable methods reflects both the sector's heterogeneity and Emelody's relatively early stage within a fragmented robotics landscape.

The triangulation supports a valuation range of $10M to $14M, with a central estimate of $12M. This range carries material uncertainty given reliance on a single method and the lack of tight peer anchors. Key unknowns affecting valuation include Emelody's revenue trajectory, profitability path, and technical differentiation relative to the broader peer cohort. Additional data on unit economics and market position would be required to narrow this band.
